primeira_execucao.p1.intro: Everything is optional, and you can change it later under Searches. The more you say, the better joBot ranks the jobs.
primeira_execucao.p1.cargos_dica: One per line, or separated by commas. Up to 20.
primeira_execucao.erro.salario: Invalid minimum salary: use numbers only, for example 5000 or 5000.50.
primeira_execucao.erro.moeda: I cannot convert that currency: pick one from the list.
primeira_execucao.erro.uf: Invalid state: use a Brazilian state code, like SP.
primeira_execucao.resumo.vazio: You skipped this part: jobs show up by date, with no fit score. You can say what you are looking for later, under Searches.
primeira_execucao.p2.explicacao: When on, joBot starts by itself when you log in and looks for jobs every 3 hours, even with the panel closed. When off, it only searches while it is open. You can change this later in settings.
primeira_execucao.p2.container: joBot will run in the container {container} (distrobox).
primeira_execucao.p2.nao_linux: Background mode only exists on Linux for now. On this computer it stays off: joBot searches while it is open.
primeira_execucao.p2.recusa: Background mode could not be turned on
primeira_execucao.p2.recusa_desligar: Background mode could not be turned off
primeira_execucao.pronto.texto: joBot can look for jobs now. Search right away, or see what is already here?
segundo_plano.sem_host_exec: could not reach the host system: distrobox-host-exec or distrobox-enter is missing
segundo_plano.systemd_nao_responde: the user systemd is not responding
segundo_plano.home_diferente: the container home folder is not the host home folder
